task1_declustering.method: Zaliapin-style nearest-neighbor eta = dt * D^1.6, D in {1 same dstIP+dport, 2 same dstIP, 3 same /24, 4 same /16}, latest-in-class parent
task1_declustering.bimodality: modes log10 eta = -2.25 (clustered) and +1.08 (independent); valley at 0.08
task1_declustering.note: eta outperforms both baselines; declustered residual = 7.2x volume reduction with 3.8x botnet enrichment

task2_pooled_gr.magnitude_def: m = log10(flow total bytes); b from OLS on log10 N(>=m) in window m in [2,4.5]

rms_rat.note: too few flows; joined pooled tail only

task2_pooled_gr.interpretation: b is environment-dependent (0.39-1.07) like regional b-values; b~1.07 for scanning/background catalogs = tectonic-like; low b (0.39 AMOS) = large-event-dominated intrusion = stressed-system analogue
